thread.title: Trump's FAKE Credit Card Interest Rate Cap Is ALL TALK
thread.title_full: Trump's FAKE Credit Card Interest Rate Cap Is ALL TALK

author: @FrankTownsend-il1wr
text: When I logged into 2 of my credit card accounts now I get a popup of getting 9.99% interest for 1 year... Citi / CapOne. They trying to bait me into using it though bc I pay 0%. Personally, think its a bad idea and I never pay interest so it doesn't matter to me. If they did that, instantly many accounts would get closed. You get a better rate by paying your bills. OK, what if we make a law that locks interest rate and prevents them from closing account... Passes congress, moves to senate...card companies instantly close before it hits president's desk. Then they deny accounts from opening unless high enough score. How to fix? Make it easier to pay bills. Get rid of waste in spending, lower gov spending, balance the budget. Inflation is a tax on all. Stop student loans as this increases tution, have companies educate for work place. Most of what you learn in college isn't used in real world, i learned most from interning while at college. Add more financial education and self control in public school. Most of the people I know in credit card debt is because they buy stuff they dont need without thinking about it. Have colleges partner with companies to teach what you actually need to know.
